accepted_domain_recovery: Both models recover training-domain behavior before intervention.
held_out_incremental_prediction: Relation-aware model predicts held-out intervention outcome.
independent_replication: Independent domain team repeats the intervention.
kill_criterion: Relations add no discrimination or fail to recover element behavior.
native_objects: Identical element inventories, intervenable relation structures and outcomes.
no_placement_rival: Feature engineering or definitional expansion without emergence language.
permutation_challenge: Randomize relation labels and structures while preserving inventories.
question: Can a relation-aware model predict an intervention better than a model with the same elements but no explicit relation structure?
survivor: D2 remains a useful configuration address.
title: Relation intervention
